packageRules.description: Held back: newer runc removed libcontainer/user, which dockertest v3 (test containers only) still imports, so `go mod tidy` fails and takes the whole grouped Go update with it. Lift when dockertest moves to v4.
Held back: newer gofish dropped the redfish and common packages bmclib v2 imports, so `go mod tidy` fails and takes the whole grouped Go update with it. Lift when bmclib supports the new layout.
bubbletea, huh and lipgloss (charm.land since v2) depend on each other and need one code migration, so their major updates arrive as one pull request.

The QEMU shards stay on the Ubuntu release the boot image is built from: UEFI test VMs do not boot with the next release's QEMU, OVMF and iPXE ROM. This rule also holds the runner of the other jobs in that file; move it by hand.
